description: Defines a class for a Bezier smoothed line chart in a graph rendering library, extending a base Bezier class and implementing methods for drawing and rendering smoothed lines with Bezier curves.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Smoothed_Line
classes.description: A class for rendering a Bezier smoothed line chart with methods for drawing and outputting the smoothed line plot.

methods.name: _getFillStyle
methods.description: Returns the fill style of the element, here a transparent color.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample representation of the line in the legend.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Outputs the Bezier smoothed plot as a line chart, handling dataset iteration, spline creation, and rendering.
